findings.title: Data transfer restriction and missing Pune entity consent
findings.deviation: The agreement prohibits transferring Customer Data outside the environment without approval and lacks sub-processor flow-downs for AtliQ's Pune entity.
findings.impact: AtliQ cannot utilize its Indian delivery center for data processing without further written consent and proper sub-processor flow-downs.
findings.quote: AtliQ shall not transfer Customer Data outside the TravelHub cloud environment without prior written approval.
findings.counterPosition: Authorize the AtliQ Pune entity as a sub-processor and permit the transfer of data for processing purposes within the AtliQ group in accordance with a DPA.

findings.title: Liability cap excludes fees payable
findings.deviation: The liability cap is calculated based only on fees actually paid rather than fees paid or payable.
findings.impact: If a claim arises before milestones are paid, the liability cap may be interpreted as zero or be significantly reduced.
findings.quote: Each Party's total liability arising out of this Agreement shall not exceed the total fees paid under this Agreement in the twelve (12) months preceding the claim
findings.counterPosition: Aggregate liability should be capped at 1x fees paid or payable in the 12 months preceding the claim.

findings.title: Indemnity mutuality limited to specific triggers
findings.deviation: The indemnity is restricted to IP and Data/Law breach rather than covering each party's general breach or negligence.
findings.impact: AtliQ is not indemnified for general third-party claims arising from the customer's own negligence or breach of contract.
findings.quote: 13.1 AtliQ shall defend and indemnify TravelHub against third-party claims alleging that the Deliverables infringe any intellectual property right. 13.2 TravelHub shall defend and indemnify AtliQ against third-party claims arising from Customer Data or TravelHub's use of the Deliverables in breach of applicable law.
findings.counterPosition: Each party should indemnify the other for third-party claims caused by its own breach or negligence.

fine.note: Absence of delay penalties is acceptable as it avoids uncapped or milestone-based penalties.
The 30-day payment term is within the 45-day maximum approved in the playbook.
IP ownership vests in the client only upon full payment and AtliQ retains its background technology.
Termination for convenience includes a 30-day notice period and payment for all work performed.
Confidentiality obligations are mutual with a standard 3-year survival period.
The non-solicitation clause is mutual and limited to a 12-month duration.
The 10-day review period includes a deemed acceptance provision.
The professional services warranty and 60-day conformity period are standard.
The agreement does not impose any insurance requirements that exceed AtliQ's current coverage.
